fusions.name: Split Point
fusions.desc: Throws a light point that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, then splits to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that.

fusions.name: Prongs Apart
fusions.desc: Drives the tines through a narrow cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 11 damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each enemy [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Turned the Other Way
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.

fusions.name: Second Tine
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a strike that fails to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
